load_steps.label: Force along the sling
load_steps.note: Equal to 2.89 t, compared with the shackle rating.

Sideways allowance

rule_set.name: ASME BTH-1, Design of Below-the-Hook Lifting Devices
ASME BTH-1, Design of Below-the-Hook Lifting Devices

checks.title: Tearing across the sides of the hole
checks.source: ASME BTH-1, pin-connected plates: tensile strength through the pinhole
checks.explanation: The pin pulls on the plate either side of the hole. Too little material there and the padeye tears straight across.

working.label: Thickness at the hole
working.substituted: t = 6 mm main plate + 2 × 6 mm cheek plates

working.label: Allowed load
working.formula: P_t = C_r F_u · 2 t b_{eff} / (1.20 N_d)

working.label: Demand: sling force on the padeye

checks.title: Splitting above the hole
checks.source: ASME BTH-1, pin-connected plates: fracture strength beyond the pinhole
checks.explanation: The material between the hole and the top edge can split along the line of the sling.

working.label: Thickness at the hole
working.substituted: t = 6 mm main plate + 2 × 6 mm cheek plates

working.label: Demand: sling force on the padeye

checks.title: Shearing out above the hole
checks.source: ASME BTH-1, pin-connected plates: double plane shear strength
checks.explanation: The pin can push a plug of material out of the top of the head along two shear lines.

working.label: Thickness at the hole
working.substituted: t = 6 mm main plate + 2 × 6 mm cheek plates

working.label: Area of the two shear planes
working.formula: A_v = 2 [a + D_p/2 (1 − cos φ) − Z] t

working.label: Demand: sling force on the padeye

checks.title: Crushing under the shackle pin
checks.source: ASME BTH-1, pin-connected plates: bearing strength
checks.explanation: The pin presses on the hole surface. Too thin a plate and it dents.

working.label: Thickness at the hole
working.substituted: t = 6 mm main plate + 2 × 6 mm cheek plates

working.label: Allowed load
working.formula: P_p = C F_y D_p t / N_d
working.note: C = 1.25 for service class 0. F_y is the lower yield of the plates at the hole.

working.label: Demand: sling force on the padeye

checks.title: Pin fits the hole closely
checks.source: ASME BTH-1 commentary on pin-to-hole clearance
checks.explanation: A loose pin concentrates the load and weakens the head. Keep the pin at least 90% of the hole diameter.

checks.title: Hole is big enough for the pin
checks.source: NEMO practice
checks.explanation: The hole must be at least 1 mm larger than the shackle pin so it fits.

checks.title: Cheek plate welds
checks.source: ASME BTH-1, welded connections: fillet weld allowable shear
checks.explanation: Each cheek plate carries its share of the pin load into the main plate through the weld around its edge.

working.label: Load carried by one cheek plate
Allowed weld stress
working.note: E_{xx} is the weld metal strength (E70XX / E7018 class electrodes).

checks.title: Cheek weld size
checks.source: AWS D1.1 minimum fillet weld size
checks.explanation: Very small welds on thick plate cool too fast and can crack. This is the smallest weld size normally allowed for this plate thickness.

checks.title: Pulling and bending at the base
checks.source: ASME BTH-1, members: combined axial tension and bending
checks.explanation: At the base the padeye is pulled upward and bent by the sloping and sideways parts of the sling force. The three effects are added.

working.label: Allowed in-plane bending
working.formula: λ = h L / t^2, then BTH-1 rectangular-bar rule
working.note: Long thin plates bent on edge can buckle sideways; λ measures that risk.

checks.title: Shear at the base
checks.source: ASME BTH-1, members: allowable shear stress
checks.explanation: The sloping and sideways parts of the sling force try to slide the padeye along its base.

checks.title: Base weld strength
checks.source: ASME BTH-1, welded connections: fillet weld allowable shear
checks.explanation: Two fillet welds, one on each face, join the padeye to the deck or structure. All forces on the weld are combined on its throat.

working.label: Normal stress on the weld
working.formula: f_n = V/A_w + H h/S_x + Q h/S_y

working.label: Allowed weld stress
working.note: E_{xx} is the weld metal strength (E70XX / E7018 class electrodes).

checks.title: Base weld size
checks.source: AWS D1.1 minimum fillet weld size
checks.explanation: Very small welds on thick plate cool too fast and can crack. This is the smallest weld size normally allowed for this plate thickness.

checks.title: Shackle is rated for the load
checks.source: Crosby G-2130 working load limit
checks.explanation: The sling force on this padeye must not exceed the shackle's working load limit. A shackle pulled at an angle to its in-line axis is rated lower, by the maker's side-loading table.

checks.title: Padeye fits inside the shackle
checks.source: NEMO practice
checks.explanation: The padeye plus cheek plates must slide into the shackle jaw with a little room.

checks.title: Padeye fills the shackle jaw
checks.source: NEMO practice (rigging guidance)
checks.explanation: A padeye much thinner than the shackle jaw lets the shackle tilt and bends its pin. Aim to fill at least 60% of the jaw, or add spacers.

working.label: Thinnest padeye that fills the jaw
Padeye thickness at the hole
working.substituted: t = 6 mm main plate + 2 × 6 mm cheek plates
